timeline.cite: Silm 13; GA (HoME XI) and Silm 9 [C] — the two annals are quoted in the clause itself: Fëanor's host at Y.T. 1497, Fingolfin's at the first rising of the Moon
timeline.what: TWO Noldorin arrivals, an age apart: Feanor's host reached Lake Mithrim in Y.T. 1497, 'before the rising of the Moon' (GA, HoME XI); Fingolfin's came 'at the first rising of the Moon' (Silm 9) and held the north-west, and it is his realm this series follows
The Bragollach beaten off at Eithel Sirion; Fingolfin falls before Angband's gate

timeline.cite: Silm 20; GA 472 §252 (HoME XI) [C] — 'Morgoth now broke his pledges to the Easterlings that had served him, and denied to them the rich lands of Beleriand which they coveted, and he sent away these evil folk into Hithlum, and there commanded them to dwell'. Header verified in the Grey Annals section: 472, one block. THE OWNER RULED 472 ON 5 AUGUST 2026, closing Lore 558. This field previously read F.A. 473, marked inferred-medium, on the reading that no annal dates the Easterlings' ARRIVAL and 473 is inferred from the Nirnaeth being 472 — but §252 dates the SENDING, which is what this sentence says, and the archive's own easterlingsfa record had cited it all along. Their later POSSESSION remains separately dated: GA §263 (488, Lorgan their chief) and HoME V (AB2) 495-6 (Brodda in his hall)
timeline.what: After the Nirnaeth, Morgoth's Easterlings are penned in Hithlum over the Edain's remnant
